title: Idlewells Indoor Market Asbestos Remedial and Refurbishment Works
description:
Nottinghamshire County Council is undertaking this procurement exercise on behalf of Ashfield District Council (ADC). Ashfield District Council are the Contracting Authority; and will be entering into the contract with the appointed contractor. 
The works shall be carried out by suitably trained and qualified professionals, who are accredited by appropriate regulatory/professional bodies in line with the requirements of the Contract.
The Contractor shall be responsible for design (where applicable), supply and installation of the works required under this contract.
The Contractor shall ensure that the Employer continually meets their statutory and legislative requirements and obligations.
The Refurbishment works aims to upgrade the market's facilities, improve safety standards, and enhance the overall environment for traders, visitors and the general public. The project involves asbestos removal though phased unit refurbishments, drainage replacement works, internal alterations for the accommodation of new toilet and plant room upgrades and design of alterations to the hot water and heating system. Below is a detailed scope of works and scope of requirements for the project. The works are to be carried out in phases to minimize disruption to market operations and ensure safety for traders, customers and workers.
Bidders are required to attend a site visit prior to submitting a tender to ensure they understand the requirements and complexities. Attendance at a site visit is a mandatory condition of participation in this procurement. Site visits must be requested via the portal and are available between 12th November - 26th November 2026 only. Any tender submitted by a tenderer who has not attended a site visit will be disqualified and excluded from further evaluation.
The services shall be provided by a Single Supplier / Service Provider.
Sub-contractors are permitted but ADC must be advised of this at the tender submission stage.
Contract length: 16 weeks Estimated start date 08 February 2027 - 31st May 2027.
 Estimated Contract Value:  In the region of £400,000 excluding VAT.

title: Highways Materials and Tools Framework
description:
The estimated framework start date is 18th December 2026 and will run until 17th December 2028, with the option to extend for a further 2 x 12 months.
The framework is for the supply and delivery of various highways materials and tools, which are required for the delivery of Highway Services in-house operations.
Highway Services operations range from routine highway maintenance works to high profile highway improvement schemes within our town centres.
The framework will comprise of 3 different Lots, these are;
Lot 1 - Miscellaneous Civil Engineering Materials, including Cements, Drainage Materials, Manhole Covers and Gully Grates, Road Marking Materials and Timber Products
Lot 2 - Site Safety Materials, including Cone Signs, Cones and Barriers, Danger Lamps, Footway Boards,
Lot 3 - Tools and consumables, including hand tools, wheelbarrows, buckets, replacement blades and sandbags.
Materials included on the framework price list are specified based on their performance properties, supported by adherence to British Standards where applicable.
Tools and consumables are specified based on their quality and where applicable compatibility with other equipment already used by the service.
Delivery timescales and depot or site locations will be stated within the framework price list and re-iterated on any orders placed, to ensure goods are delivered on time and to the correct location.
The supply and delivery cost on the price list, is what will be evaluated and used to obtain the positions on the framework. While it is rare that collections from suppliers is needed, suppliers will be asked to provide a price for collection, should the need to required.
